lessonTitle: 37. The linear function and its graph
lessonTitleEnglish: The linear function and its graph
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: y = kx + b is a linear function; its graph is a straight line, so two points are enough to draw it.
stages.headlineEnglish: y = kx + b is a linear function; its graph is a straight line, so two points are enough to draw it.

stages.headline: b shows where the line crosses the Oy axis, at (0; b); lines with the same k are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: b shows where the line crosses the Oy axis, at (0; b); lines with the same k are parallel.

stages.headline: For k = 0, y = b is a line parallel to Ox. Find the axis intercepts by setting x = 0 and y = 0.
